description: Single authoritative list of protected, shared, enforcement-excluded and enforcement-allowlisted addresses (Task 26C, F-8). Attribution config v3 and policy 2.1+ pin this file by canonical digest and must not repeat these lists.
protected_cidrs_note: Loopback/link-local; cowrie_default (legacy), cowrie_relay_frontend, cowrie_cowrie_internal; demo .1 (unused) and the demo relay .2.
enforcement_excluded_sources_note: Demo control client: permanently excluded from any enforcement action.
enforcement_allowlist_note: The only address a future enforcement controller may target (demo test client). Not used by threat scoring.
